name: Absolute Truth
overview: Scripture reveals that absolute truth is grounded in the unchanging character and words of God, who neither lies nor repents (Numbers 23:19). Believers are called to trust fully in the Lord rather than their own understanding (Proverbs 3:5), recognizing that every word of God is pure and reliable (Proverbs 30:5). Jesus Christ Himself declares that He is the truth and the exclusive way to the Father (John 14:6), and the Holy Spirit, called the Spirit of truth, guides believers into all truth (John 16:13). Knowing this truth brings freedom (John 8:32), underscoring the centrality of Christ and God’s Word in discerning and living by absolute truth.
